titulo: Quiz — The five questions everyone asks you
introPt: A traveller stays in the conversation and walks away with a recommendation.
cenario: A stranger strikes up a conversation.

dialogo.es: Di dove siete? È la prima volta in Italia?
dialogo.pt: Where are you from? Is this your first time in Italy?

dialogo.es: Siamo di Boston. No, la seconda.
dialogo.pt: We're from Boston. No, the second.

dialogo.es: Mi piace tantissimo, soprattutto i mercati.
dialogo.pt: I like it enormously, the markets above all.

dialogo.es: Allora domani deve andare a quello di Sant'Ambrogio. Meno turisti.
dialogo.pt: Then tomorrow you have to go to the Sant'Ambrogio one. Fewer tourists.

perguntas.pergunta: Why prepare the five answers in advance?
opcoes: So you spend the conversation listening instead of assembling
perguntas.explica: The gain is attention, not the sentences.

perguntas.pergunta: What does mi piace tutto do to a conversation?
opcoes: Ends it — there is nothing to improve on
perguntas.explica: Naming one thing gets you the local version.

perguntas.pergunta: What is the whole trick after answering?
opcoes: Ask one of the same questions back
Lei is safe with anyone older, working, or newly met; follow if they switch
perguntas.explica: You are never wrong for having started with lei.

perguntas.pergunta: You lost the thread. What do you do?
opcoes: Say mi sono perso and ask for a repeat
perguntas.explica: Leaving with a polite smile is the only costly version.
